title: Batuta's aggregated daily summary
description: Deprecated v1 compatibility contract. This release has no public uploader; `batuta summary` emits v2 locally. A pre-provisioned controlled importer may submit v1 during the compatibility window. Contains no prompt, prompt hash, turn ID, path, response, credential, or secret.

schema.description: Format version. If the set of fields changes, the suffix changes — historical series don't get silently patched.

day.description: Aggregated UTC day (data::day_utc). UTC, not local timezone: local timezone leaks an approximation of where the person is.

installation.description: Stable legacy derivation from the local salt (home::installation_id). Carries no hostname, username, or path.

batuta_version.description: CARGO_PKG_VERSION of the binary that generated the line. Without this, comparing days across different versions is comparing different rulers.

mode.description: Where the aggregated data came from. Today the CLI writes 'local'; 'degraded' marks data collected via MCP (§4.1), where there is no hook and the funnel is incomplete.

routes.description: Turns seen by the router during the day (funnel denominator).

routes_suggested.description: Turns in which the router spoke. routes - routes_suggested = silence (which is a desirable result, not a failure).

routes_holdout.description: Turns in which the router stayed silent on purpose. This local label is descriptive, not causal evidence.

suggested_arm.description: Client aggregates cannot attest outcomes; both values must be zero.

holdout_arm.description: Client aggregates cannot attest outcomes; both values must be zero.

declared_bias.description: Fixed phrase that travels along with the data (§1.5). The bias doesn't become a footnote on the site: it stays glued to the line.

skills.description: One entry per skill suggested during the day, in alphabetical order (Rust's BTreeMap). Empty is a legitimate response: a day with no routes.

skill.description: Skill name as it appears in the local frontmatter.

version.description: Version declared by the skill. Empty string when the skill doesn't version itself — and that, in itself, is data about the quality of the ecosystem.

routes.description: Number of times the router suggested this skill.

activations.description: Number of times the skill actually fired. activations ÷ routes is the trigger rate (§4.4).

user_activations.description: Subset of activations triggered by the user, not by the model (OTEL event claude_code.skill_activated).

turns_ok.description: Only independently signed LAB receipts can establish success.

reprompts.description: Hard proxy for a bad outcome — doesn't depend on the judge.

cost_usd.description: Untrusted local cost observation; ranking uses receipt-backed LAB cost for judged outcomes.

median_turns_to_completion.description: Median, not average: one outlier turn with 40 back-and-forths shouldn't drag the number.

ghost.description: routes ≥ 5 and activations = 0. A skill the router keeps suggesting that nobody uses.
